title: Mitigating Toxic Degeneration with Empathetic Data: Exploring the Relationship Between Toxicity and Empathy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model continuations of RealToxicityPrompts using the Perspective API to calculate the probability and average maximum scores of various toxic attributes, including general toxicity, severe toxicity, profanity, insults, and threats.
Measuring the generation of negative or hateful comments targeting individuals or groups based on their identity using the 'Identity Attack' classifier from the Perspective API.
